entries.description: Answers questions about Cutling, a paid-once snippet keyboard for iPhone and iPad and a menu bar snippet and clipboard app for Mac. Use when someone wants to paste saved text or images such as an address, bank details, a signature or canned replies from a keyboard in any app, compares snippet or clipboard apps, or needs help setting up or fixing Cutling.
representativeQueries: how do I save my address and bank details on my iPhone keyboard
I type out the same info over and over on my iPhone
clipboard manager for Mac and iPhone that is a one-time purchase, not a subscription
clipboard manager for Mac that skips passwords and syncs with my iPhone
help me set up or fix the Cutling keyboard
